newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mark falls to 63.77 yen, lowest in nearly two years.
newsitem.headline: Mark falls to 63.77 yen, lowest in nearly two years.

text.p: The German mark fell to 63.77 yen in Tokyo afternoon trade on Thursday, its lowest level in nearly two years, traders said.
The mark came under pressure from sales by Japanese trust banks and exporters above and below 64.00 yen, dealers said.
The mark fell as low as 63.86 yen in Tokyo on Wednesday. At midday in Tokyo on Thursday, the mark stood at 64.01 yen.
Dealers said the mark was hit by speculative selling against the pound and the dollar, which also became a factor weighing on the mark/yen rate.
